items.title: Announcing: New Windows App client-side endpoints for Azure Virtual Desktop
items.titleKo: Announcing: New Windows App client-side endpoints for Azure Virtual Desktop
items.summaryKo: Beginning in early October 2026, Windows App will begin using three new wildcard fully qualified domain names (FQDNs) for client-side service traffic to Azure Virtual Desktop. These domains are already included in the cloud-side connectivity requirements.
